current_wp206.separate_not_in_scope: External same-inode SQLite data/schema revision fencing remains a separate WP206 discriminator and is not merged into G5.

refined_result: The SQLite data_version candidate remains useful as research/diagnostic evidence, but its F2 product surface is now narrow. WP206 write and G4 legacy recovery already use BEGIN IMMEDIATE plus fresh row validation/CAS; WP901 G4 now binds the restart checkpoint and exact persisted-row evidence inside one SQLite read snapshot. Therefore data_version must not be added broadly. It should be tested only on a concrete authority-sensitive load-to-use boundary outside these mechanisms.
retirement_rule: If no such unprotected load-to-use consumer exists, or if its downstream generation/attestation/effect gates already reject stale evidence, retire EXTERNAL_SQLITE_REVISION_FENCE/v1 as redundant product code while preserving the research evidence.
promotion_rule: Promote only if exact-current E4 reproduces a stale protected load-to-use continuation that baseline accepts and a connection-local data_version hint plus targeted revalidation closes without falsely rejecting unrelated UnifiedDB writes.
